cases.source: Create a left-to-right order fulfillment flowchart. A customer submits an order. Validate the order. If invalid, reject it and notify the customer. If valid, check inventory. If unavailable, place the order on backorder and notify the customer. If available, authorize payment, reserve inventory, ship the order, and send delivery confirmation. Label both decision outcomes and keep the successful path visually dominant.
required_conditions: Decision outcomes are visibly labeled
The successful path reads left to right
Failure branches remain visually distinct

cases.source: Create a clear left-to-right architecture diagram for an IoT monitoring platform. Group multiple sensors and an edge gateway in a Field zone. Put the ingestion API, stream processor, time-series database, notification service, and web dashboard in a Cloud zone. Sensors send telemetry to the gateway; the gateway sends it to the ingestion API and stream processor; the processor writes the database and sends alerts; the dashboard reads the database. Emphasize the main telemetry path.
required_conditions: Field and Cloud zones are visually distinct
All children remain inside their zone
The telemetry path has primary visual emphasis
forbidden_conditions: A connector crosses a zone title
The database uses an ordinary process shape
Secondary edges obscure the telemetry path

cases.source: Create a contained smart-camera component schematic. Put Image Sensor, Processor, Memory, Radio, and Power Controller inside Camera Housing. Image Sensor sends frames to Processor; Processor reads and writes Memory; Processor sends encoded video to Radio; Power Controller supplies the four other internal components. Put Cloud Service outside and connect it bidirectionally to Radio. Add readable reference numerals 110 through 150 to the five internal components.
required_conditions: All five internal components are inside Camera Housing
Cloud Service is outside Camera Housing
Reference callouts are legible and traceable
forbidden_conditions: Containment is implied only by proximity

cases.source: Create a dense but readable incident-response process. Alert Intake leads to Triage. Triage branches to False Positive Closure, Standard Investigation, or Major Incident. Standard Investigation gathers evidence, contains the issue, eradicates the cause, recovers service, and performs review. Major Incident additionally activates Incident Command, Legal, Communications, and Executive Notification before joining containment. Show escalation and feedback from review to detection tuning without crossing labels.
required_conditions: The main lifecycle remains traceable
The major-incident fan-out is grouped
The feedback route stays outside the main flow corridor
forbidden_conditions: Feedback looks like a normal forward step

cases.source: Create an edge-to-cloud platform with an On-Premises container and a Cloud Platform container. Inside On-Premises, place a Factory Network container holding Sensors, PLC, and Edge Gateway. Inside Cloud Platform, place an Ingestion container with API Gateway and Message Broker, plus an Analytics container with Stream Processor, Data Lake, and Dashboard. Show the telemetry path and the dashboard query path.
required_conditions: Nested containers have visible headers and padding
Cross-boundary telemetry remains clear
Children do not collide with container titles
forbidden_conditions: A child extends outside its parent

cases.source: Create a patent-oriented schematic for fluid-control assembly 100. Housing 110 contains inlet valve 120, pressure sensor 130, controller 140, actuator 150, and outlet valve 160. Fluid flows from the inlet valve through the outlet valve. The pressure sensor reports pressure to the controller, and the controller commands the actuator, which operates both valves. Place reference numerals outside component labels and route leaders without crossing other labels.
required_conditions: Every numbered component has one unambiguous callout
Fluid and control relationships use distinct styles
The housing boundary remains clear
forbidden_conditions: A callout leader crosses a component label
Control flow can be mistaken for fluid flow

cases.source: Create a left-to-right governance workflow using these exact labels: Submit Proposed Customer Data Retention Policy; Privacy and Regulatory Compliance Assessment; Information Security Architecture Review; Business Data Owner Approval; Legal Exception and Risk Acceptance; Publish Approved Retention Schedule. Compliance Assessment and Security Review run in parallel, then join before Business Data Owner Approval. A rejected owner decision routes to Legal Exception and Risk Acceptance and then returns for approval.
required_conditions: Exact labels remain readable without truncation
Parallel reviews align as peers
The rejection loop is visually secondary
forbidden_conditions: The return loop crosses an unrelated label

cases.source: Create a service interaction diagram with Client, API Service, Cache, Primary Database, and Audit Sink. Client calls API Service. API Service reads and writes Cache using one bidirectional connector, reads and writes Primary Database using one bidirectional connector, retries itself on transient failure using a self-loop labeled Retry, and sends audit events to Audit Sink. Make arrow direction and labels unmistakable.
required_conditions: Each reciprocal relationship uses one connector
The Retry self-loop is distinct and readable
Arrowheads remain on visible boundaries
forbidden_conditions: Reciprocal arrows are doubled or stacked
The self-loop crosses the API Service label

drafting_constraints: Use red only for trust boundaries
Keep the authorization path on one horizontal axis
Route audit writes below the main path
Show untrusted external systems outside the trust boundary

required_conditions: The main authorization path shares one horizontal axis
External systems remain outside the trust boundary
Audit writes route below the primary corridor
forbidden_conditions: Audit routes cross the authorization path
Trust boundaries are shown only as labels

uncertainties: The source image does not establish whether Audit Log is inside the application boundary

required_conditions: Visible labels and directions survive import
The uncertainty remains explicit for professional review
No unsupported application boundary is invented
forbidden_conditions: Uncertainty is silently converted into containment
